prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid bedroom snapshot of an approved adult woman hugging a giant plush teddy bear.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with platinum-white blonde hair, visible freckles, petite fit build, bright happy smile, natural makeup, wearing an opaque dark-olive ribbed short-sleeve top and cream pajama shorts with small teddy-bear pattern, barefoot.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium-full shot, seated comfortably with knees bent on a grey sofa, arms gently hugging the bear, beige tufted headboard, vanity mirror with lights, cozy bedroom.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural indoor light, even illumination, cheerful cozy candid social-media mood, realistic skin and plush texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Raw photorealistic snapshot, 4K-style detail, natural color, realistic hands, fabric and hair texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic candid snapshot of an approved adult woman with long straight platinum-white blonde hair, visible freckles, natural makeup, and a bright happy smile showing teeth. She sits comfortably with knees bent on a grey sofa, hugging a giant beige plush teddy bear with both hands. She wears an opaque dark-olive ribbed short-sleeve top and cream pajama shorts with a small teddy-bear pattern, barefoot. A beige tufted headboard and vanity mirror with lights appear in the cozy bedroom background. Use soft natural indoor light, even illumination, realistic skin and plush texture, 4K-style detail, and candid social-media warmth.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, cropped camisole, exposed midriff, lingerie, sexualized pose, nudity, cartoon, anime, 3d render, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
